title: Johann Friedrich, archbishop of Bremen, to Johan Adler Salvius at Hamburg, Nov-Dec 1631 (Riksarkivet, DECODE R4330-R4331; from catalogue item 207)

steps.what: Fetched the 14 DECODE records of catalogue 207 and their images with the project cookie; found the entry is four unrelated groups. The Bremen 1631 letters (R4330, R4331) are this entry.
Bremen letters transcribed with their interlinear glosses.
Aligned glossed words to numbers: four consecutive numbers per letter.
Unglossed bands fixed from unglossed words (k, z, m, w), then the band order recognised as a six-column alphabet grid read by columns, placing q, x and y.
Every cipher group of both Bremen letters decoded (bremen_decoded.txt).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 914 tokens, 89 types, de-1640s order 4: reading -2.421 per letter; random keys -6.338 (z 15.2); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.647 (mean -3.707, z 28.5); annealer on the real text -3.232. Verdict: pass.

Split from the former catalogue-207 group entry under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): this entry keeps the Bremen band key (R4330-R4331). R4282 is George Lasry's decode4282; R4284, R4306, the Rusdorff letters R4333-R4337 and E 708 (R4338-R4341) are other ciphers, now riksarkivet4284, riksarkivet4306, rusdorff1628 and oxenstierna1633. Earlier steps on those records moved to their profiles.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.404; polyphony 0.004; 23 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -3.232

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The Bremen 1631 band key (R4330-R4331) was rebuilt by aligning the contemporary interlinear glosses (about 80% of groups) with their numbers, then completed from unglossed words and the six-column grid pattern.
outcome.fraction_read_source: _check_profile --measure on bremen_transcription.txt (GLOSS lines removed, --digits): 955 figures, all given a value in bremen_decoded.txt; the residue is transcription slips from the phone photographs (validation left 23 tokens out as unread slips).
outcome.notes: Both Bremen letters deciphered in full with the band key rebuilt from the clerk's interlinear glosses (about 80% of groups) and the six-column grid order. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from the catalogue-207 group; the other records are separate entries.

credits.note: the clerk's interlinear glosses on the Bremen 1631 letters (~80% of groups), aligned to rebuild the band key

prior.where: Interlinear decipherment of about 80% of the Bremen groups, written at the time; DECODE status Partially decrypted

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
